 ADVERTISEMENT   Filtered By: Showbiz Showbiz 'PBB Collab 3.0': Get to know Ethan Benares, Ang Sporty Palangga ng Bacolod 
 By NIKA ROQUE , GMA News Published November 1, 2026 1:32pm 
 + Add GMA on Google Make this your preferred source to get more updates from this publisher on Google. Photo: Mark Caceres via Ethan Benares/IG Ethan Benares is slowly making his name known inside "Pinoy Big Brother: Collab Edition 3.0."
 Dubbed the Sporty Palangga ng Bacolod, the young Sparkle star started his career as a contestant on the second edition of the talent search Sparkle Campus Cutie before making his way to Bahay ni Kuya.
 Here's what you need to know about Ethan.
 1. He is a BS Psychology student 
 Other Stories
 PBB: Piolo Pascual, Darren Espanto, more stars visit Bahay ni Kuya

 'PBB Collab 3.0': Who is Winwyn Marquez, 'Ang Reyna Mama ng Parañaque'?
 When Ethan competed in Sparkle's Campus Cutie, he was introduced as the "Morenong Beach Boy ng Bacolod City." In his introduction video, Ethan shared that he is a first year student, taking up BS Psychology at the University of St. La Salle.
 Ethan's favorite subject is math, saying that he finds it "therapeutic."
 "Once you start understanding the formulas, you start solving them easily. And that is why I love math," he said.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Sparkle GMA Artist Center (@sparklegmaartistcenter) 
 2. Ethan loves water sports 
 Ethan is all about sports, especially those involving water.
 In his Campus Cutie introduction video, he loves camping, boating, fishing, and jet-skiing.
 "As long as it's the sea, I'm g," Ethan said.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ethan Benares (@ethan.benares) 
 3. He is a fitness buff 
 Aside from his love for outdoor sports, Ethan is also a gym buff.
 On Instagram, he would post his workouts, starting with stretching to exercises with weights.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ethan Benares (@ethan.benares) 
 4. He plays basketball 
 Ethan also enjoys playing basketball and has played some hoops with the Campus Cutie contestants.
 On Instagram, he posted some of his game highlights, showing his well-rounded skills. He could shoot, pass, finish, and even block shots.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ethan Benares (@ethan.benares) 
 5. Ethan is a mama's boy 
 Ethan is one proud mama's boy.
 He previously posted photos with his mother on Instagram, showing their bonding session at a mall.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by Ethan Benares (@ethan.benares)
